_doc: AG Dash's keyboard shortcuts (spec: ag-dash-keys.md). Actions and `when`s are defined in ag-board's index.html (search agKeys). Format: ag-board/dot-local/share/ag-board/keys.js.

bindings.label: open the card (transcript, live screen, reply)
archive (closes the tab; Undo for a few seconds)
State / Lists / Workspaces / Routines / ag-rules view
write a reply (the box starts unfocused, like a Gmail thread)
undo the last archive (in a field with text: the field's own undo)
new item. Also: ask “where's the one about …” and it shows the cards; housekeeping (“pin the roblox ones”) goes to a brief session in Meta
new item / find a session (same as c, works while typing)
leave the reply box, then close the panel
dictate in the open editor (stop sends it)
